From the potbanks of the Potteries to the gig economy’s algorithmic discipline, from mass unemployment to managed abandonment, Jonas Marvin charts the tragedy of the British working-class and its decomposition — and possible revival — with impressive empirical and theoretical rigour.

## 

Amazon.com: The Breaking of the English Working Class ...
